ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% medium-to-high intensity gray/white pixels across the lateral lobes vs. 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central notch and peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, low-intensity contiguous dark region extending from the central notch downwards; diffuse medium-intensity gray mottling across both lobes with localized high-intensity white circular rings on the left lobe and near the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 3 to 12 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the median notch to the lateral tips, with a secondary concave dip just before the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring patterns (rosettes) distributed across the left lobe and the central dark region, likely indicative of previous barnacle attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three distinct, dark, nearly parallel diagonal linear marks visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of white, calcareous-textured protrusions (barnacles) concentrated on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small, white, regularly spaced nodes along the leading edge where it enters the water line.
